name: apex
description: APEX (Ask. Perfect. EXecute.): Claude Code plugin with the APEX Firewall, a prompt injection firewall for AI agents (9 attack types, 11 input sources, Haiku/Sonnet/Opus cascade).
author: Thunder-13 <saravananofficial13@gmail.com>

scripts.test: export HOME="$(mktemp -d)" APEX_HOME="$PWD/apex"; for t in apex/tests/*.test.js apex/tests/pif/*.test.js; do echo "== $t"; node "$t" > /dev/null || { echo "FAILED: $t"; exit 1; }; done; node apex/tests/pif/eval.js | tail -4
